description: Defines Bluetooth GATT socket and attribute classes, including Attribute management, GATTSocket communication, and command handling for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) GATT operations.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT attribute with serialization/deserialization and type management.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Manages BLE GATT socket communication, including MTU negotiation, notifications, and command execution.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Command
classes.description: Encapsulates GATT commands such as read, write, and discovery operations, with response handling.

methods.description: Constructor initializing attribute with data stream.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Resets attribute type, offset, and length.

methods.name: Load(TYPE& value) const
methods.description: Loads attribute data into provided variable.

methods.name: Security(const uint8_t level)
methods.description: Sets security level for the socket.

methods.description: Executes a GATT command with timeout.

methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously with callback.
